pipeline_status: component_validation; not registered for model selection
query_domain: one independently normalized query per call; caller owns batch/head/causal mapping
gqa_mapping: integer division, including ratio3; no cross-batch KV sharing
allocation: borrow existing LlmVectorBody UB arrays; no additional storage
hardware_flags: existing worker-local CompleteDma event7; no cross-core channels
completion: output MTE3 complete before return; external event belongs to executor
model_admission: requires actual CTG/solver binding, layer/full-model teacher/greedy checks and sourced prices
